title: Mode Dock Stack Drag From Tab Gap
description: When dragging between the last tab and the fullscreen button, the window stack should be moved all at once.
summary: Dragging the tab-bar gap (between the last tab and maximize/close controls) now starts a stack-level dock drag: the whole tab stack is extracted from the layout, shown as a window preview, and relocated via split/root-split drops while tab drags keep single-tab behavior.
